## Round 1: Phone insurance

```{=html}
<!--
  Claim tracker for "Insure the Class", Round 1.
  Paste this whole slide into a revealjs .qmd.

  Settings (on the .ig div below):
    data-claim-cost  cost of one claim in dollars (default 500)
    data-expected    expected cost per customer, shown when you press
                     "Show expected cost" (default 100 = 20% x $500)

  To reuse on another slide (e.g. Round 2 "careful" vs "clumsy"),
  copy only the <div class="ig"> ... </div> block. The style and script
  only need to appear once in the deck, and every .ig block runs on its own.
-->
<div class="ig" data-claim-cost="500" data-expected="100">
  <div class="ig-actions">
    <button type="button" class="ig-btn ig-none" data-act="none">No claim</button>
    <button type="button" class="ig-btn ig-claim" data-act="claim">Claim <span class="ig-btn-sub" data-out="costlabel">$500</span></button>
  </div>

  <div class="ig-stats">
    <div class="ig-stat"><div class="ig-num" data-out="n">0</div><div class="ig-lab">Customers</div></div>
    <div class="ig-stat"><div class="ig-num" data-out="k">0</div><div class="ig-lab">Claims <span data-out="rate"></span></div></div>
    <div class="ig-stat"><div class="ig-num" data-out="total">$0</div><div class="ig-lab">Claim costs</div></div>
    <div class="ig-stat ig-key"><div class="ig-num" data-out="avg">–</div><div class="ig-lab">Average cost per customer</div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="ig-gauge">
    <div class="ig-track">
      <div class="ig-fill" data-out="fill"></div>
      <div class="ig-expected" data-out="exptick"><span></span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="ig-scale"><span>$0</span><span data-out="max">$500</span></div>
  </div>

  <div class="ig-dots" data-out="dots" aria-label="Outcomes so far: green no claim, red claim"></div>

  <div class="ig-tools">
    <button type="button" class="ig-small" data-act="expected">Show expected cost</button>
    <span class="ig-spacer"></span>
    <button type="button" class="ig-small" data-act="undo">Undo</button>
    <button type="button" class="ig-small" data-act="reset">Reset</button>
  </div>
</div>

<style>
.reveal .ig {
  --ig-ok: #1d6b52;
  --ig-bad: #a8322a;
  --ig-accent: #24476b;
  --ig-line: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  --ig-line: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 16%, transparent);
  text-align: left;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  margin-top: 0.3em;
}
.reveal .ig .ig-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 24px; }
.reveal .ig .ig-btn {
  font: inherit; font-size: 1.05em; font-weight: 700;
  padding: 0.5em 0.8em; border: 3px solid; border-radius: 14px;
  background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: center; gap: 0.45em;
  transition: transform 0.08s, background-color 0.15s;
}
.reveal .ig .ig-none  { color: var(--ig-ok); }
.reveal .ig .ig-claim { color: var(--ig-bad); }
.reveal .ig .ig-btn:hover  { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 9%, transparent); }
.reveal .ig .ig-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
.reveal .ig button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ig-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }
.reveal .ig .ig-btn-sub { font-weight: 400; font-size: 0.6em; opacity: 0.85; }

.reveal .ig .ig-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 18px; margin: 26px 0 34px; }
.reveal .ig .ig-stat { border-top: 3px solid var(--ig-line); padding-top: 8px; }
.reveal .ig .ig-key { border-top-color: var(--ig-accent); }
.reveal .ig .ig-num { font-size: 1.3em; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; }
.reveal .ig .ig-key .ig-num { color: var(--ig-accent); }
.reveal .ig .ig-lab { font-size: 0.48em; opacity: 0.75; margin-top: 4px; }

.reveal .ig .ig-gauge { margin-bottom: 18px; }
.reveal .ig .ig-track { position: relative; height: 22px; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--ig-line); }
.reveal .ig .ig-fill {
  position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 0;
  border-radius: 11px; background: var(--ig-accent); transition: width 0.35s ease;
}
.reveal .ig .ig-expected {
  display: none; position: absolute; top: -8px; bottom: -8px;
  width: 3px; margin-left: -1.5px; background: currentColor;
}
.reveal .ig.show-expected .ig-expected { display: block; }
.reveal .ig .ig-expected span {
  position: absolute; bottom: 100%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  white-space: nowrap; font-size: 0.45em; font-weight: 700; padding-bottom: 2px;
}
.reveal .ig .ig-scale { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.42em; opacity: 0.65; margin-top: 4px; }

.reveal .ig .ig-dots { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; min-height: 14px; max-height: 52px; overflow: hidden; }
.reveal .ig .ig-dot { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ig-ok); }
.reveal .ig .ig-dot.is-claim { background: var(--ig-bad); }

.reveal .ig .ig-tools { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; margin-top: 16px; }
.reveal .ig .ig-spacer { flex: 1; }
.reveal .ig .ig-small {
  font: inherit; font-size: 0.42em; padding: 0.35em 0.9em; color: inherit;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--ig-line); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
}
.reveal .ig .ig-small:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: default; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .reveal .ig .ig-btn, .reveal .ig .ig-fill { transition: none; }
}
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  var MAX_DOTS = 90;
  var money = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-AU', { style: 'currency', currency: 'AUD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
  var fmt = function (v) { return money.format(v); };

  document.querySelectorAll('.ig:not([data-ready])').forEach(function (root) {
    root.dataset.ready = '1';
    var cost = Number(root.dataset.claimCost) || 500;
    var expected = Number(root.dataset.expected) || 0;
    var hist = []; // 1 = claim, 0 = no claim
    var out = function (name) { return root.querySelector('[data-out="' + name + '"]'); };

    out('costlabel').textContent = fmt(cost);
    out('max').textContent = fmt(cost);
    var tick = out('exptick');
    tick.style.left = Math.min(expected / cost, 1) * 100 + '%';
    tick.querySelector('span').textContent = 'Expected ' + fmt(expected);

    function render() {
      var n = hist.length;
      var k = hist.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0);
      var total = k * cost;
      out('n').textContent = n;
      out('k').textContent = k;
      out('rate').textContent = n ? '(' + Math.round((100 * k) / n) + '%)' : '';
      out('total').textContent = fmt(total);
      out('avg').textContent = n ? fmt(total / n) : '–';
      out('fill').style.width = n ? (100 * total) / n / cost + '%' : '0';

      var dots = out('dots');
      dots.innerHTML = '';
      hist.slice(-MAX_DOTS).forEach(function (c) {
        var d = document.createElement('span');
        d.className = 'ig-dot' + (c ? ' is-claim' : '');
        dots.appendChild(d);
      });
      root.querySelector('[data-act="undo"]').disabled = !n;
    }

    root.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var b = e.target.closest('button[data-act]');
      if (!b) return;
      var act = b.dataset.act;
      if (act === 'none') hist.push(0);
      else if (act === 'claim') hist.push(1);
      else if (act === 'undo') hist.pop();
      else if (act === 'reset') {
        if (hist.length && !window.confirm('Clear all customers for this round?')) return;
        hist.length = 0;
      } else if (act === 'expected') {
        var on = root.classList.toggle('show-expected');
        b.textContent = on ? 'Hide expected cost' : 'Show expected cost';
      }
      b.blur(); // hand keyboard focus back to reveal.js so arrow keys still change slides
      render();
    });

    render();
  });
})();
</script>
```
